chunks: And Yūnus ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated from ʿAbdullāh ibn Sulaymān, who said:
I heard Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام say: “Whoever grants a man safety over his life, then kills him, will come on the Day of Judgment carrying the banner of treachery.”
ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Bāqir عليه السلام say about killing someone after giving him safety?
ai.summary: This hadith condemns betraying a person after granting him security and safety. It portrays such treachery as a grave moral crime whose disgrace will be exposed on the Day of Judgment.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4943 - Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman narrated from Abdullah ibn Sulayman, who said:

I heard Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) say:
"Whoever grants a man safety over his life and then kills him will come on the Day of Judgment carrying the banner of treachery."
